title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro Flagship Trillion-Scale MoE Model
summary: DeepSeek-V4-Pro is a 1.6 trillion parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model released in April 2026 for high-performance reasoning and agentic tasks. It features a native 1-million-token context window and extreme architectural efficiency through Hybrid Attention.
research_notes: Optimized for autonomous coding and complex agentic workflows; utilizes only 10% of the KV cache compared to previous generations.

evolution.summary: Launched as a successor to V3 in April 2026, introducing Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) and FP4 quantization-aware training. It represents the latest flagship evolution in the DeepSeek series.
